name: wds_vtab-kitti_closest_vehicle_distance
description: A vision regression task derived from KITTI (via VTAB-style processing) that asks models to estimate the closest vehicle distance in an image. It evaluates a model's ability to infer metric depth-related information from single RGB frames, relevant to autonomous driving perception. The benchmark focuses on fine-grained spatial reasoning and distance prediction accuracy.
reputation: Part of VTAB-style and CLIP-benchmark collections; recognized within vision/robustness communities but not as widely cited as core KITTI tasks.
